P.expected_type: ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ) (ell : ℤ) (x : Module.End ℂ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (h_H001 : p.Prime ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < (p : ℤ)) (h_H002 : FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧ h * x - x * h = (2 : ℂ) • x ∧ h * y - y * h = (-2 : ℂ) • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h ∧ (∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = (ell : ℂ) • w) ∧ (∀ W : Submodule ℂ V, Chevalley.stable W x → Chevalley.stable W y → Chevalley.stable W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤)) (h_H003 : v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = (ell : ℂ) • v) (h_H004 : (∃ (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M) (B : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V), ∀ i, (b i : V) = B i) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, Chevalley.preserves M (Chevalley.dp x r) ∧ Chevalley.preserves M (Chevalley.dp y r))), Nontrivial (Chevalley.VK K M) ∧ ∀ W : Submodule K (Chevalley.VK K M), Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M x) → Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M y) → Chevalley.stable W (Chevalley.opK K M h) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤

correspondence.explanation: All original data remain arbitrary: a prime p, any characteristic-p field K, integer 0≤ell<p, an irreducible complex highest-weight module of the given dimension, its chosen highest vector, and any admissible lattice. H002 expresses the sl2 representation by complex-linear generators with exactly its three defining commutators, the stated dimension, highest-weight-vector existence and irreducibility under those generators; H003 fixes the chosen vector. H004 is exactly a simultaneous integer/complex basis plus stability under every divided power, equivalent to stability under the Z-algebra they generate. An additive subgroup is uniquely a Z-submodule. Positive integer primes are encoded by Nat primes; Index identifies with 0≤i≤ell. The canonical tensor flip identifies K⊗Z M with the source M⊗Z K, intertwining the induced operators. T005 proves restriction is in its preservation branch. Nontrivial means the vector space is nonzero, and forall Submodule with bottom/top says exactly every K-linear subspace stable under x,y,h is zero or the whole space. This is equivalent in both directions to invariance under their K-linear Lie span. No algebraic closure, p>2, positive ell or special lattice is assumed. ModN used in N005 is the actual quotient by p multiples, and its two equivalences are required with their natural generator formulas.
